liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Not Fade Away** (1 other source): A Bid You Goodnight jam appears in Not Fade Away at 9:34 [1]

## The recordings

- **gd70-11-10.aud.cotsman.17032.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 4 songs; 27 min; rated 1.75/5 by 4 [1]. Said about its sound: A small splice or dropout occurs about 0:43 into Not Fade Away; Not Fade Away sounds far worse than The Other One, which differs markedly in quality; The Not Fade Away > Caution jam is nearly unlistenable, but sound changes at the end of drums [1][3][4]
- **gd70-11-10.aud.hanno.8837.sbefail.shnf**: audience recording; 2 songs; 26 min [2]. Said about its sound: Weinberg-reel Not Fade Away sounds quite good, but 11:50 to 14:00 is patched from an inferior cassette after the reel runs out [2]

## Around the show

- Reviewer suspects this Not Fade Away and Caution are the same as the 9/20/70 performance, based on timings [3]
- The Other One actually comes from the Port Chester show of 2-23-71 [5]
- Not Fade Away is from Weinberg's 9/20/70 audience tape and The Other One from 2/23/71, not this date [6]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd70-11-10.aud.cotsman.17032.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Marty Weinberg; source: Audience Partial [1]. Also: A higher-generation source is patched in from 12:30 to the end of Not Fade Away; Sound Forge normalized and pitch-corrected the first two tracks; A Betty Board circulates for that Port Chester show and the whole 2-18 to 2-24 run; The tape apparently derives from a Marty Weinberg compilation reel [1][5][6]
- **gd70-11-10.aud.hanno.8837.sbefail.shnf**: taped by Marty Weinberg; transferred by Uli Tuete, Jack Warner and Hanno Bunjes; source: Audience Partial [2]. Also: Not Fade Away comes from a 2-CD set made directly from Marty Weinberg's reels; The Other One comes from an inferior audience source, sped up 2%, and cuts at 12:11 rather than 6:46 [2]
